integrity: Self-contained argument and stdlib exact coefficient/finite-field checker. Same-model reviewed only; no external audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Only 3-primary torsion in H3 for unordered four-particle configurations on simple K_{a,b} with a,b>=7; no statement for smaller parts, other primes or other homological degrees. Relies on An Proposition 5.1 and chessboard shellability.
title: Three-primary torsion vanishes for four-point configurations of large complete bipartite graphs
